lines.zh: 我鼓起来，鳃里全是菌丝。
lines.en: I puff up, gills full of mycelium.

lines.zh: 顺着流走，省得跟它较劲。
lines.en: I ride the flow rather than fight it.

lines.zh: 别蹭珊瑚，它一碎就浑水。
lines.en: Don't scrape the coral; it clouds the water.

lines.zh: 水面咕噜响，像有东西在敲。
lines.en: The surface gurgles like something knocking.
The shallows are too bright; I'm going deeper.
My bubbles trail like waymarkers.
The undertow shoves me off course.
A flick of my tail moves me half a block.
Salt laced with blood, up ahead.

lines.zh: 我鼓成一团，鳞里全是蓝菌。
lines.en: Puffed into a ball, blue fungus in every scale.

lines.zh: 我鼓起来时，刺比身体还长。
lines.en: Puffed up, my spines outgrow my body.
Follow behind my spines, not into them.

lines.zh: 水底的石头，我一颗颗数。
lines.en: I count the stones on the riverbed one by one.
The water's warm; my fins obey today.

lines.zh: 水里那点毒，我早习惯了。
lines.en: That water's poison is old news to me.

lines.zh: 船板卡在礁缝里，挡住了路。
lines.en: Wreck planks jam the reef gap, blocking my way.
I puff up, and every spine stands.

lines.zh: 想不起味道，只记得壳硬。
lines.en: I forget the taste; I remember shells being hard.
The boat shadow passed overhead.

lines.zh: 我鼓起来，刺都是幽匿做的。
lines.en: I puff up, my spines all sculk.

lines.zh: 我在等一片被感染的鱼群。
lines.en: I wait for a school of infected fish.

lines.zh: 光斑落在沙上，我在里面。
lines.en: A patch of light lands on the sand, and I'm in it.
My spine tips glow blue, lighting the sand.

lines.zh: 鼓起来，我这一身全是刺。
lines.en: Puffed up, and every bit of me is spines.

lines.zh: 珊瑚高得像塔，我绕着塔根转。
lines.en: The coral towers; I circle its base.
My poison comes from the fungus.

lines.zh: 安静得能听见自己磨牙。
lines.en: Quiet enough to hear my own teeth grind.
Soaking makes me drowsy.
A sculk puffer soaks in deep water.

lines.zh: 礁石后面有声，像水漏进洞。
lines.en: A sound behind the reef, like water into a hole.
You hold your breath; I take my time.
Smell of iron hook - stay back.

lines.zh: 你身上有岸上的味道，我闻到了。
lines.en: You smell of dry land; I noticed.
You don't touch me, I don't raise spines.
Sculk Pufferfish? I'll remember that.

lines.zh: 你呼出的气泡，比我整条鱼还大。
lines.en: Your breath bubbles are bigger than my whole body.
Dry sand still clings to your feet.

lines.zh: 你划水的样子，像翻倒的船。
lines.en: You swim like a capsized boat.
That light makes me squint.

lines.zh: 你从水底看，像一根长草。
lines.en: From below you look like a tall reed.

lines.zh: 刺都倒了，再来就撑不住。
lines.en: My spines are flat; another hit and I'm done.
My fins went limp; I can only drift.
My dorsal fin split; I swim crooked.
I'm still puffed full of air.
A sculked puffer's venom changes too.
Don't poke my belly - it's softest.

lines.zh: 鼓起来的身子，被戳漏了。
lines.en: My puffed body got poked through.

lines.zh: 八点血，鼓起来也挡不住。
lines.en: Eight health — puffing up doesn't stop it.
Held too long; I need the surface.
I turned belly-up in the mud.
Swim over and leave me a bite.
Worms turned up in the sand - my favorite.

lines.zh: 香味勾着我，钩子也吓着我。
lines.en: The smell pulls me; the hook frightens me.
Eight health, puffed up to bluff.

lines.zh: 我鼓起来，不是吓你，是急。
lines.en: I puff up not to scare you, but with eagerness.
Scattered so thick - I can't finish it.

lines.zh: 我鼓起来的时候，别碰刺。
lines.en: When I swell, mind the spines.
Just one sniff, honestly.
This beats chewing weed ten times over.

lines.zh: 你手里东西在飘香，是腐肉吗？
lines.en: That smells good; is it rotten flesh?
You crash through and the pressure warps.
You take deep water; I hug the sandy floor.

lines.zh: 我一鼓起来，全是幽匿刺。
lines.en: Puffed up, I am all sculk spines.

lines.zh: 鼓起来了，别戳我这层刺。
lines.en: I am puffed up, do not poke these spines.

lines.zh: 水一波一波，撞得我打转。
lines.en: The water surges; I spin.
My spines are flattened; I can't smooth them.

lines.zh: 我一鼓起来，刺就全竖着。
lines.en: When I puff up, every spine stands.
I puff up heavier than you.

lines.zh: 小鳍被你撞得贴在身上。
lines.en: You pinned my little fin to my side.
I'm puffing up - don't crowd me.
Your spine tips glow red like a burnt sunset.

lines.zh: 涨潮时，我们把卵埋进沙。
lines.en: At high tide we'll bury the eggs in sand.
This season, the sculk picks only you.

lines.zh: 绕珊瑚三圈，直到光回来。
lines.en: Three turns round the coral, until light returns.
When I puff up, I am all spines.

lines.zh: 一摆一摆，把暗流都梳顺了。
lines.en: Each sway combs the current smooth.

lines.zh: 水底的幽匿，正往我这聚。
lines.en: The sculk on the bottom gathers toward me.
The sand nest is pressed; only you are missing.

lines.zh: 循着蓝光，我游过三条沟。
lines.en: I followed blue light through three trenches.
A shell with sculk veins still in it.
I nudge this shard back toward you.

lines.zh: 河豚的刺，现在也是绿的。
lines.en: Even my spines are green now.
Bury it deep, before the undertow takes it.
Heavy enough that I drag along the sand.
I'll find a place for this one.
My mouth is full; even my spines won't close.

lines.zh: 木头味，带着旧钉子的锈。
lines.en: Smells of timber and old nail rust.
This fits in the sculk heap.
Slick as oil, not like scales.
Puff me up and I'm all spines.

lines.zh: 潮水退到最低，终于等到。
lines.en: The tide is at its lowest - finally.

lines.zh: 水里那团影子，骗不了我。
lines.en: That shadow in the water doesn't fool me.
Sculk made my spines more venomous.

lines.zh: 一口咬住，毒刺同时竖起。
lines.en: My bite lands as my spines rise.
My body bends like a loosed arrow.
It is alone; I go first.

lines.zh: 幽匿河豚，在水里鼓起来。
lines.en: The sculk puffer swells in the water.
It moves, and my spines align.

lines.zh: 沙面鼓起一小包，在那儿。
lines.en: A small bump in the sand - there.
I puff my spines. One chance only.

lines.zh: 你喘得比我快，我听得见。
lines.en: I hear you panting faster than me.

lines.zh: 水底的味，顺着幽匿上来了。
lines.en: The scent from the depths rides up the sculk.
Swim fast if you like; you still need air.

lines.zh: 等你进刺的范围，我就鼓。
lines.en: Come within spine range and I'll puff.
I'll follow you into the sand.

lines.zh: 我的刺带着幽匿的味道。
lines.en: My spines taste of sculk.
I can wait a whole tide.

lines.zh: 我鼓起来的时候，全身都是刺。
lines.en: When I puff up, I'm all spines.
Its tail is slowing - almost mine.

lines.zh: 气泡一个个破，就是倒计时。
lines.en: Each bubble that pops is a countdown.
In this shallows, the spines are mine.
Puff up and rattle your bones.
Puffers have teeth, made for shells.

lines.zh: 刺里有毒，退了还来得及。
lines.en: My spines are venomous; retreat while you can.
Salty, with a note of sculk.
One more sting from these burning spines.

lines.zh: 鼓胀的肚子里还有一口气。
lines.en: There's still a charge in my swollen belly.
Eggs fill this sand pit - don't step.

lines.zh: 毒刺扎进手指，会肿一天。
lines.en: A spine in your finger will swell all day.
When I puff up, don't touch.
Only the weed sways; no one waits.

lines.zh: 先缩进石缝，把刺收一收。
lines.en: First I tuck into a crevice and fold my spines.
My fins move a beat late.

lines.zh: 水里有铁和腐叶的味道。
lines.en: The water tastes of iron and rotting leaves.
I recognize this shade of sand.

lines.zh: 先巡半圈，确认没有钩线。
lines.en: Half a lap first, to check for hooks.

lines.zh: 顺着腐水漂来，浑身是菌。
lines.en: I drifted down the rot-stream, steeped in fungus.
Puffed up, I can't sink.
So deep a blue that light sinks away.
Sculk water runs green.
Fire on the surface; the heat scalds my gills.
I fell and puffed up into a ball.

lines.zh: 张嘴只会灌进风，咽不下。
lines.en: Opening my mouth only gulps wind.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀翻水底，我滚进礁缝。
lines.en: The blast flips the seabed; I tumble into a reef gap.

lines.zh: 箭从岸上射下来，扎进沙里。
lines.en: An arrow from the bank stabs into the sand.
A cold ache in my bones - sorcery.
Nothing left to eat in this water.
Lightning hit the water and numbed me to the bone.

lines.zh: 往下望，连幽匿光都灭了。
lines.en: Below, even the sculk light goes out.
